name: Handles
summary: Polyamide U handles, polyamide handles with square aluminium rod, adjustable plastic handles (PAH series) and adjustable zinc alloy handles.

facts.label: Polyamide
facts.value: U handles A, B, C; type D with aluminium rod

intro: Handles for panels and enclosures in six styles. Polyamide U handles come in types A, B and C; type D pairs polyamide with a square aluminium rod; the adjustable range is available in plastic (PAH series) and zinc alloy. Dimensions and fixing details are in the datasheet.
